Dynamic Saunas Serena model DYN 6229 03 FS, a 2 person, full spectrum infrared sauna that combines far infrared, mid infrared, and near infrared heating with a near zero EMF design. The first 205 characters highlight the major benefits, including full spectrum infrared heat, near zero EMF performance, Canadian Hemlock construction, and a compact 2 person layout crafted for indoor spaces.

Inside, the Serena features seven heating panels, blending carbon far infrared heaters with near infrared elements for a broader therapeutic range. The cabin includes a tempered glass door, LED digital control panel, Bluetooth audio system, and chromotherapy lighting with a red light therapy option.
The sauna uses a 120 volt 15 amp plug and play setup, allowing installation on most indoor circuits without specialized wiring. Its blend of near zero EMF technology, full spectrum heating, and spa inspired Hemlock design makes it ideal for home gyms, wellness rooms, and relaxation spaces.
